section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single present study that examined associations between multiple facets of positive body image (body appreciation, body image flexibility, body pride, and body acceptance by others) and multidimensional well-being in a large online sample of British adults. The authors planned to examine sex and age differences and associations with self-reported BMI, noting prior literature suggesting small-to-moderate sex and age effects and an inverse relationship between BMI and facets of positive body image. No explicit study numbering (e.g., 'Study 1') is present in this section.
